content.short: Seamless Protocol is the primary native lending protocol on Base, featuring under-collateralized borrowing.
content.description:
Seamless Protocol is the leading decentralized, non-custodial lending and borrowing platform built natively for the Base network. As a community-driven project with a focus on maximum capital efficiency, the protocol introduces innovative Integrated Liquidity Markets (ILMs). These allow for specialized under-collateralized borrowing strategies that are pre-defined and transparently managed on-chain, significantly reducing the capital required for sophisticated financial operations.

Deeply integrated with the Base ecosystem, Seamless Protocol provides users with professional-grade liquidity tools and optimized interest rates within a user-friendly interface. The platform is powered by the SEAM token, which was distributed via a fair launch to align the long-term interests of the community. By leveraging the security and throughput of the Base network, Seamless is building the essential infrastructure for the next generation of decentralized banking, empowering participants to build and manage diversified portfolios with ease.
content.meta: Seamless Protocol offers native decentralized lending and under-collateralized borrowing on the Base network.
